class.name: PHASEAudioStreamPlayer3D
class.brief_description: Plays spatialized 3D audio through Apple's PHASE framework.
class.description: A drop-in replacement for Godot's [AudioStreamPlayer3D] that routes audio through Apple's PHASE spatial audio engine. Supports spatial mixing with distance attenuation, channel-based output for surround formats (5.1, 7.1, etc.), and ambient mixing. Provides control over direct path, early reflections, and late reverb send levels. Assign an [AudioStream] to the [member stream] property and call [method play] to begin playback. The node's 3D position is used by PHASE for spatialization.

method.name: get_playback_position
method.description: Returns the current playback position in seconds.

method.name: get_stream_playback
method.description: Returns the [AudioStreamPlayback] object associated with this player.

method.name: get_volume_linear
method.description: Returns the volume as a linear value (where [code]1.0[/code] is 0 dB).

method.name: has_stream_playback
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if an [AudioStreamPlayback] is currently active.

method.name: play
method.description: Starts playback of the assigned [member stream] from the given position in seconds.

method.name: seek
method.description: Seeks to the given position in seconds during playback.

method.name: set_volume_linear
method.description: Sets the volume as a linear value (where [code]1.0[/code] is 0 dB).

members.member: If [code]true[/code], audio plays automatically when the node enters the scene tree.
The distance beyond which the PHASE framework doesn't process this sound. A value of [code]0.0[/code] disables distance culling.
The send level for the direct path signal. Controls how much of the dry audio signal reaches the listener without reverb processing. Only applies when [member mixer_type] is [constant MIXER_SPATIAL].
The send level for early reflections. Controls the amount of audio routed to the early reflections reverb stage. Only applies when [member mixer_type] is [constant MIXER_SPATIAL].
If [code]true[/code], the direct audio path from source to listener is active. Only applies when [member mixer_type] is [constant MIXER_SPATIAL].
If [code]true[/code], early reflections are active for this source. Only applies when [member mixer_type] is [constant MIXER_SPATIAL].
If [code]true[/code], late reverb is active for this source. Only applies when [member mixer_type] is [constant MIXER_SPATIAL].
The send level for late reverb. Controls the amount of audio routed to the late reverb stage. Only applies when [member mixer_type] is [constant MIXER_SPATIAL].
The maximum number of simultaneous voices this player can use. Calling [method play] while at the limit will stop the oldest voice. Behaves like [member AudioStreamPlayer3D.max_polyphony].
The PHASE mixer type used for this audio source. Determines how audio is spatialized and rendered. See [constant MIXER_SPATIAL], [constant MIXER_CHANNEL], and [constant MIXER_AMBIENT].
The pitch scale factor. A value of [code]2.0[/code] doubles the pitch, [code]0.5[/code] halves it.

Controls distance-based volume attenuation. At [code]1.0[/code], sound reduces by 6 dB for every doubling of distance between source and listener. At [code]2.0[/code], the loss doubles. At [code]0.5[/code], the loss halves. Only applies when [member mixer_type] is [constant MIXER_SPATIAL].
The [AudioStream] to play. PHASE spatializes the raw audio from this stream.
If [code]true[/code], playback is paused. Set to [code]false[/code] to resume.

The volume in decibels. A value of [code]0.0[/code] is full volume. Because PHASE source gain is capped at [code]1.0[/code] (linear), values above [code]0.0[/code] dB are silently clamped to unity gain and will not amplify the signal.

signal.name: finished
signal.description: Emitted when playback reaches the end of the stream.

constants.constant: Audio specifies a position and orientation in 3D space. Requires a [PHASEAudioListener3D] in the scene. Sound playback changes depending on the relative positions of the listener and source. Supports direct path, early reflections, and late reverb sends.

Maintains the channel configuration of the source audio. For example, the left and right channels of a stereo input play on the left and right speakers, respectively. Also supports surround formats (5.1, 7.1, etc.). No 3D spatialization.
Overrides the output channels to give the mixer an orientation, creating the effect of pointing in a specific direction in 3D space.
